items.label: la douleur
items.scene: A young angler hops on one foot holding his sore toe, a big shiny fish-shaped LURE ("doo-LUHR") dangling from his rod: what PAIN!

items.label: la fièvre
items.scene: A polar bear with a FEVER ("FYEHVR") sits in a tub of ice cubes, a big thermometer in his mouth.

items.label: la cicatrice
items.scene: An old sailor shows the doctor a pale SCAR on his forearm, while his pots of drooping SICK TREES ("see-kah-TREES") wait beside him.

items.label: la coupure
items.scene: A boy pours PURE water from a glass jug over the tiny CUT on his finger: "COO, that's cold!" ("koo-PEWR"), a plaster ready on the table.

items.label: le docteur
items.scene: The DOCTOR, a kind woman with a stethoscope, listens to a teddy's heart while her cat PURRS ("TURRR") on the stool.

items.label: le vertige
items.scene: A mountain goat on top of the tall step-ladder clutches it with VERTIGO ("vehr-TEEZH"), eyes spinning in spirals.

items.label: médical
items.scene: Dr CAL ("may-dee-KAHL") opens his MEDICAL bag and finds a hamster asleep among the rolled bandages.
